svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: what's Sand building right now? Latest: Grow the agent chat from Sand's resume in TheSandemon (#7, merged, Sep 25). The plan, straight from the PR: Open to work is pinned right after the intro. It covers the roles Sand wants, the pitch, and an email to reach out. Day job now shows the current role (Access Control Coordinator, U.S. Embassy Panama), with the Nicosia and Gameloft roles as earlier jobs. Deep dives on LadderStar, BloodHound (with stat tiles), Port Visualizer and the Create: Aeronautics mods, including the ConcurrentModificationException fix. 6 files touched (+383 / -39), 1 test file included: harness-chat.svg, profile-visuals.json, chat_svg.py and 3 more.
